content.short: Base Bridge is the official tool for securely transferring ETH and other assets between Ethereum and the Base network.
content.description: Base Bridge is the official infrastructure for transferring assets between Ethereum and the Base network, a Layer 2 developed by Coinbase. It serves as the primary gateway for users to bridge ETH and supported tokens, enabling interaction with the diverse ecosystem of dApps on Base. The bridge operates through decentralized smart contracts, ensuring the security of all transfers. While bridging to Base is instantaneous, withdrawals follow standard security protocols for optimistic rollups. As a foundational component, the bridge lowers the barrier to entry for users seeking faster and cheaper transactions on an Ethereum-secured Layer 2 while exploring the world of decentralized apps.
